# Spec v1

## Goals
- Keep a local list of habits.

## Non-goals
- None.

## User stories
- **S1 (P1):** As a user, I can record a habit.
- **S2 (P2):** As a user, I can see my recorded habits.
- **S3 (P3):** As a user, I can rename a habit.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1 (S1):** WHEN I save a habit THE SYSTEM SHALL store it locally.
- **AC2 (S2):** WHEN I open the list THE SYSTEM SHALL show my habits.
- **AC3 (S3):** WHEN I rename a habit THE SYSTEM SHALL display its new name.

## Assumptions
- **A1 [fixed]:** No paid services.
- **A2 [delegated]:** Use a local file for storage.

## Open questions
None.
